name: Moonshot AI
h1: Moonshot AI ARR: $1B Annualized, $300M→$1B in Two Months.
intro: Moonshot AI, the Beijing lab behind Kimi, told investors its annual recurring revenue passed $1 billion in August 2026 — more than 3x in roughly two months after the release of Kimi K3. The reported timeline below is assembled from Dealroom, 36Kr and Bloomberg reporting; RMB figures are converted to USD.

modelTitle: How Kimi Subscriptions and Token APIs Split the Revenue.
modelParagraphs: Moonshot monetizes Kimi two ways: consumer subscriptions to the Kimi chatbot (a low-priced China-market tier, historically around RMB 49–99/month) and a token-based API for K-series models, now increasingly sold into coding-agent and enterprise workloads. The August surge was API-led, driven by Kimi K3 adoption among agent platforms and overseas developers paying per million tokens at aggressive discounts to US labs.

The company's $3.5 billion mid-2026 raise at ~117x the then-current ARR prices in continued hypergrowth — management's own target of $2 billion annualized by December 2026 implies another doubling in four months.

faqs.q: What Is Moonshot AI's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: Moonshot AI told investors its annual recurring revenue passed $1 billion in August 2026, up from about $300 million in June–July — a more than 3x jump attributed largely to the Kimi K3 release. Management targets $2 billion annualized by year-end.

faqs.q: How Fast Did Moonshot AI Grow?
faqs.a: Roughly $200M annualized in April 2026, ~$300M by June–July, then $1B in August — the steepest leg came in about two months after Kimi K3 shipped. Earlier figures are estimates from Chinese press; the lab has never filed a clean public revenue timeline.

faqs.q: What Does Moonshot AI Actually Sell?
faqs.a: Subscriptions to the Kimi chatbot plus token-based API access to its K-series models, with 2026 growth concentrated in coding-agent and enterprise API usage priced well below comparable US frontier models.

About $50 billion per 2026 reporting. In July 2026 the company raised $3.5 billion at a roughly $35 billion valuation — about 117x the ~$300M ARR it reported at the time. A Hong Kong listing is reportedly under consideration.

faqs.q: How Does This Compare With Other Chinese AI Labs?
faqs.a: Moonshot's $1B ARR in August 2026 put it in the same tier as DeepSeek and Zhipu's mid-year run rates, though Zhipu annualized to ~$1.6B the same month. All three monetize via low-priced APIs and report through press and filings rather than standard ARR disclosures.
